WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO webhook_events (event_id, request_id, event_type, status, payload_hash, payload)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'processed', $4, $5::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) WHERE status = 'processed' DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 'processed'::text AS status
), dup AS (
  INSERT INTO webhook_events (event_id, request_id, event_type, status, reason, payload_hash, payload)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, 'duplicate', 'event id already processed', $4, $5::jsonb
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING 'duplicate'::text AS status
)
SELECT status FROM ins UNION ALL SELECT status FROM dup;

INSERT INTO webhook_events (event_id, request_id, event_type, status, reason, payload_hash)
VALUES (COALESCE($1,'unknown'), COALESCE($2,'unknown'), $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING status;
